subject: general
question:
Study the following bar graph and answer the question below. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bfcbca7ff232679a9c187d6f1982fed97acff097af16a0b4a3e12ee30f62669.png] 

What is the average number of cancer cases over the years?
solution:
**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of values / Number of values

**Calculation:**

Sum of the cases = 4300 + 4500 + 5000 + 5000 + 6000 + 5500

⇒ Sum of the cases = 30300

Number of years = 6

Average number of cases = 30300 / 6

⇒ Average = 5050 cases

**Therefore, the average number of cancer cases over the years is 5050.**
